name: note-synthesis
description:
Synthesizes and connects concepts across multiple sets of notes for learners, identifying patterns, contradictions, and relationships between sources. Produces an integrative summary that goes beyond individual note sets.
Use when a learner asks to connect ideas across notes, synthesize multiple readings, find patterns across study materials, or integrate notes from different lectures or sources.
Do NOT use for single-source note taking (use `cornell-notes`), for concept mapping of one topic (use `concept-mapping`), or for academic literature review (use `literature-search`).
